actions.name: agent_activity_create
actions.description: Publishes an activity to your agent’s session and updates its lifecycle. Thoughts and actions report ongoing work; a response completes the turn unless it has the continue signal, an elicitation waits for user input, and an error records a failed turn. The session must be unarchived and owned by the authenticated app user. Use the agent app’s OAuth or workload identity token; personal API keys cannot publish agent activities.

agentSessionId.description: The UUID of the unarchived session to publish to. The session’s appUser must be the user represented by your agent token; an app cannot publish activities to another agent’s session.

content.description: The activity as a JSON object. Use {type: "thought", body: "Searching the repository"} for progress, response for an answer, error for a failure, or elicitation to ask for input. These types require a Markdown body. An action instead requires action and parameter strings, and may include a Markdown result. body and result each accept up to 250,000 characters. A response normally completes the turn; add signal: continue when more work follows.

contextualMetadata.description: Metadata about user-provided contextual information for this agent activity.

ephemeral.description: Hide this activity after the next activity. Defaults to false; only thought and action activities can be ephemeral.

id.description: The identifier in UUID v4 format. If none is provided, the backend will generate one.

signal.description: An optional instruction for handling the content. Use continue only with a response to keep the turn active. Use auth or select only with an elicitation, and provide the matching signalMetadata. stop is reserved for user prompts and cannot be published through agentActivityCreate. Omit this field for normal handling.

signalMetadata.description: Details required by auth and select signals. For auth, provide a valid url, optionally providerName, and optionally a userId UUID identifying who should authenticate. That userId limits the authentication control in Linear, not access to the activity. For select, provide options: an array of 1–100 objects with a nonempty value and optional label, each up to 256 characters. Omit this field for other signals.

initiativeId.description: The identifier of the initiative to remind about.

userId.description: The user identifier to whom the notification will be sent. By default, it is set to the initiative owner.

select.description: What to get back, as a GraphQL selection, e.g. "id title state { name }"; leave out for the usual fields

actions.select: lastSyncId success

actions.name: create_project_update_reminder
actions.description: Create a notification to remind a user about a project update.

projectId.description: The identifier of the project to remind about.

userId.description: The user identifier to whom the notification will be sent. By default, it is set to the project lead.

select.description: What to get back, as a GraphQL selection, e.g. "id title state { name }"; leave out for the usual fields

actions.select: lastSyncId success

actions.name: custom_view_create
actions.description: Creates a saved view owned by you. Choose an issue, project, initiative, or update filter and set shared if others in its scope should use it. Display settings can be saved separately with viewPreferencesCreate.

color.description: Hex color for the view’s icon, such as #5E6AD2.

description.description: The description of the custom view.

and.description: Compound filters, all of which need to be matched by the feed item.

author.description: Filters that the feed item author must satisfy. UserFilter with any of: active, admin, and, app, assignedIssues, createdAt, displayName, email, id, invited, isInvited, isMe, name, or, owner, updatedAt

createdAt.description: Filters by creation time. Use a fixed timestamp or a relative duration, such as `{ gte: "-P7D" }` for resources created in the last seven days. DateComparator with any of: eq, gt, gte, in, lt, lte, neq, nin

id.description: Filters by the resource's stable UUID. Use `eq` for one ID or `in` for a list of IDs. IDComparator with any of: eq, in, neq, nin

or.description: Compound filters, one of which need to be matched by the feed item.

projectUpdate.description: Filters that the feed item's project update must satisfy. ProjectUpdateFilter with any of: and, createdAt, id, or, project, reactions, updatedAt, user

relatedInitiatives.description: Filters that the related feed item initiatives must satisfy. InitiativeCollectionFilter with any of: activityType, ancestors, and, canceledAt, completedAt, createdAt, creator, customIdentifier, every, health, healthWithAge, id, initiativeUpdates, labels, leadTeam, length, name, or, owner, priority, projects, searchableContent, slugId, some, startedAt, status, targetDate, teams, updatedAt

relatedTeams.description: Filters that the related feed item team must satisfy. TeamCollectionFilter with any of: ancestors, and, createdAt, every, id, length, or, parent, some, updatedAt

updateHealth.description: Comparator for the project or initiative update health: onTrack, atRisk, offTrack StringComparator with any of: contains, containsIgnoreCase, containsIgnoreCaseAndAccent, endsWith, eq, eqIgnoreCase, in, neq, neqIgnoreCase, nin, notContains, notContainsIgnoreCase, notEndsWith, notStartsWith, startsWith, startsWithIgnoreCase

updateType.description: Comparator for the update type: initiative, project, team StringComparator with any of: contains, containsIgnoreCase, containsIgnoreCaseAndAccent, endsWith, eq, eqIgnoreCase, in, neq, neqIgnoreCase, nin, notContains, notContainsIgnoreCase, notEndsWith, notStartsWith, startsWith, startsWithIgnoreCase

updatedAt.description: Filters by the last meaningful update time. Some background changes do not advance it. Use `gte` and `lt` together to select a time window. DateComparator with any of: eq, gt, gte, in, lt, lte, neq, nin

feedItemFilterData.description: Filter for a view of updates. Sets the view’s modelName to FeedItem when no project or initiative filter is set.

accumulatedStateUpdatedAt.description: Comparator for the issue's accumulatedStateUpdatedAt date. NullableDateComparator with any of: eq, gt, gte, in, lt, lte, neq, nin, null

activity.description: Filters that the issue's activities must satisfy. ActivityCollectionFilter with any of: and, createdAt, every, id, length, or, some, updatedAt, user

addedToCycleAt.description: Conditions on when the issue joined its current cycle. Changing cycles resets this time; removing the cycle clears it. NullableDateComparator with any of: eq, gt, gte, in, lt, lte, neq, nin, null

addedToCyclePeriod.description: Conditions on when the issue joined its cycle. before includes the cycle’s first 24 hours; during covers the remaining time before closure, and after covers times at or after closure. CyclePeriodComparator with any of: eq, in, neq, nin, null

ageTime.description: Compares the elapsed time from creation to the start of the query's database transaction. The duration is null for completed or canceled issues. Accepts ISO 8601 durations or milliseconds. NullableDurationComparator with any of: eq, gt, gte, in, lt, lte, neq, nin, null

and.description: Conditions that the issue must all match. These are combined with the other fields in this filter.

archivedAt.description: Conditions on when the issue was archived. Also set includeArchived on the query; a filter alone does not include records excluded by the query’s archive setting. NullableDateComparator with any of: eq, gt, gte, in, lt, lte, neq, nin, null

assignee.description: Conditions on the assigned user. For example, null: true finds unassigned issues, while id: { eq: "user-uuid" } selects one assignee. NullableUserFilter with any of: active, admin, and, app, assignedIssues, createdAt, displayName, email, id, invited, isInvited, isMe, name, null, or, owner, updatedAt

attachments.description: Conditions on the issue’s external links. For example, some with a URL or sourceType condition finds issues with at least one matching attachment. AttachmentCollectionFilter with any of: and, createdAt, creator, every, id, length, or, some, sourceType, subtitle, title, updatedAt, url

autoArchivedAt.description: Conditions on when the issue was automatically archived. Include archived issues in the query to find them; restoring an issue clears this value. NullableDateComparator with any of: eq, gt, gte, in, lt, lte, neq, nin, null

autoClosedAt.description: Conditions on when the issue was automatically closed after inactivity. The value is cleared when its status changes. NullableDateComparator with any of: eq, gt, gte, in, lt, lte, neq, nin, null

canceledAt.description: Conditions on when the issue entered a canceled or duplicate status. The value is cleared when the issue leaves those status types. NullableDateComparator with any of: eq, gt, gte, in, lt, lte, neq, nin, null

children.description: Conditions on direct sub-issues. Use some for a matching child, every for all children, or length to count them. This does not search all descendants recursively. IssueCollectionFilter with any of: accumulatedStateUpdatedAt, activity, addedToCycleAt, addedToCyclePeriod, ageTime, and, archivedAt, assignee, attachments, autoArchivedAt, autoClosedAt, canceledAt, children, comments, completedAt, createdAt, creator, customerCount, customerImportantCount, cycle, cycleTime, delegate, description, dueDate, estimate, every, hasActiveAgentSessions, hasBlockedByRelations, hasBlockingRelations, hasDismissedAgentSessions, hasDuplicateRelations, hasErroredAgentSessions, hasMergedAgentPullRequests, hasRelatedRelations, hasSharedUsers, hasSuggestedAssignees, hasSuggestedLabels, hasSuggestedProjects, hasSuggestedRelatedIssues, hasSuggestedSimilarIssues, hasSuggestedTeams, id, labels, lastAppliedTemplate, leadTime, length, needs, number, or, parent, priority, project, projectMilestone, reactions, recurringIssueTemplate, releases, searchableContent, sharedWith, slaBreachesAt, slaStatus, snoozedBy, snoozedUntilAt, some, sourceMetadata, startedAt, state, subscribers, suggestions, team, title, triageTime, triagedAt, updatedAt

comments.description: Conditions on comments linked directly to the issue, including replies. Inline comments on the issue description are linked through documentContent and are not included by this filter. CommentCollectionFilter with any of: and, body, createdAt, documentContent, every, id, initiative, initiativeUpdate, issue, length, needs, or, parent, project, projectUpdate, reactions, some, updatedAt, user

completedAt.description: Conditions on the recorded completion time. Use null: false to require a completion time, or a date range to find issues completed during that period. NullableDateComparator with any of: eq, gt, gte, in, lt, lte, neq, nin, null

createdAt.description: Filters by creation time. Use a fixed timestamp or a relative duration, such as `{ gte: "-P7D" }` for resources created in the last seven days. DateComparator with any of: eq, gt, gte, in, lt, lte, neq, nin

creator.description: Filters that the issues creator must satisfy. NullableUserFilter with any of: active, admin, and, app, assignedIssues, createdAt, displayName, email, id, invited, isInvited, isMe, name, null, or, owner, updatedAt

customerCount.description: Conditions on the number of distinct customers with active requests linked to the issue. Requests without a customer record each count separately. Supply one comparison; to apply a range, put separate customerCount conditions in and. NumberComparator with any of: eq, gt, gte, in, lt, lte, neq, nin

customerImportantCount.description: Conditions on the number of distinct customers with active, important requests linked to the issue. Important requests without a customer record each count separately. Supply one comparison; to apply a range, put separate customerImportantCount conditions in and. NumberComparator with any of: eq, gt, gte, in, lt, lte, neq, nin

cycle.description: Conditions on the assigned cycle. Use null: true for issues without a cycle or whose team has cycles disabled. Use null: false to require an assigned cycle on a team with cycles enabled. Other cycle comparisons do not require cycles to be enabled. NullableCycleFilter with any of: and, completedAt, createdAt, endsAt, id, inheritedFromId, isActive, isFuture, isInCooldown, isNext, isPast, isPrevious, issues, name, null, number, or, startsAt, team, updatedAt

cycleTime.description: Compares the elapsed time from work starting to completion. The duration is null if either timestamp is missing. Accepts ISO 8601 durations or milliseconds. NullableDurationComparator with any of: eq, gt, gte, in, lt, lte, neq, nin, null

delegate.description: Filters that the issue's delegated agent must satisfy. NullableUserFilter with any of: active, admin, and, app, assignedIssues, createdAt, displayName, email, id, invited, isInvited, isMe, name, null, or, owner, updatedAt

description.description: Conditions on the issue’s stored description text. Use null to find issues without a stored description, or text comparisons to match its contents. NullableStringComparator with any of: contains, containsIgnoreCase, containsIgnoreCaseAndAccent, endsWith, eq, eqIgnoreCase, in, neq, neqIgnoreCase, nin, notContains, notContainsIgnoreCase, notEndsWith, notStartsWith, null, startsWith, startsWithIgnoreCase

dueDate.description: Conditions on the due date, without a time of day. Use null: true for issues without a due date. NullableTimelessDateComparator with any of: eq, gt, gte, in, lt, lte, neq, nin, null

estimate.description: Conditions on the stored numeric estimate in the team’s scale. Use null to find unestimated issues; zero is a separate, explicit estimate. EstimateComparator with any of: and, eq, gt, gte, in, lt, lte, neq, nin, null, or

hasActiveAgentSessions.description: Comparator for filtering issues bucketed as having active agent sessions, no closed agent pull requests, and no merged agent pull requests. RelationExistsComparator with any of: eq, neq

hasBlockedByRelations.description: Whether another issue blocks this issue, with both issues still open. A link with a closed issue counts under hasRelatedRelations instead. RelationExistsComparator with any of: eq, neq

hasBlockingRelations.description: Whether this issue blocks another issue, with both issues still open. A link with a closed issue counts under hasRelatedRelations instead. RelationExistsComparator with any of: eq, neq

hasDismissedAgentSessions.description: Comparator for filtering issues bucketed as having all agent sessions dismissed or closed, and no merged agent pull requests. RelationExistsComparator with any of: eq, neq

hasDuplicateRelations.description: Whether other issues have been marked as duplicates of this issue. This checks incoming duplicate links, not whether this issue is itself a duplicate. RelationExistsComparator with any of: eq, neq

hasErroredAgentSessions.description: Comparator for filtering issues bucketed as having an errored agent session, no active sessions, and no merged agent pull requests. RelationExistsComparator with any of: eq, neq

hasMergedAgentPullRequests.description: Comparator for filtering issues which have agent-session-linked pull requests that were merged. RelationExistsComparator with any of: eq, neq

hasRelatedRelations.description: Whether the issue has a related link in either direction. Blocking links also count as related when either issue is closed; open blocking relationships are covered by hasBlockingRelations and hasBlockedByRelations. RelationExistsComparator with any of: eq, neq

hasSharedUsers.description: Comparator for filtering issues which have been shared with users outside of the team. RelationExistsComparator with any of: eq, neq

hasSuggestedAssignees.description: Comparator for filtering issues which have suggested assignees. RelationExistsComparator with any of: eq, neq

hasSuggestedLabels.description: Comparator for filtering issues which have suggested labels. RelationExistsComparator with any of: eq, neq

hasSuggestedProjects.description: Comparator for filtering issues which have suggested projects. RelationExistsComparator with any of: eq, neq

hasSuggestedRelatedIssues.description: Comparator for filtering issues which have suggested related issues. RelationExistsComparator with any of: eq, neq

hasSuggestedSimilarIssues.description: Comparator for filtering issues which have suggested similar issues. RelationExistsComparator with any of: eq, neq

hasSuggestedTeams.description: Comparator for filtering issues which have suggested teams. RelationExistsComparator with any of: eq, neq

id.description: Matches the issue UUID or human-readable identifier, such as ENG-123. Use number with a team filter when matching only the numeric portion. IssueIDComparator with any of: eq, in, neq, nin

labels.description: Conditions on assigned labels. Use some for at least one matching label, every to constrain all labels, or length: { eq: 0 } for unlabeled issues. Separate some conditions in and can require different labels on the same issue. IssueLabelCollectionFilter with any of: and, createdAt, creator, every, id, isGroup, length, name, null, or, parent, some, team, updatedAt

lastAppliedTemplate.description: Filters that the last applied template must satisfy. NullableTemplateFilter with any of: and, createdAt, id, inheritedFromId, name, null, or, team, type, updatedAt

leadTime.description: Compares the elapsed time from creation to completion. The duration is null for issues without a completion time. Accepts ISO 8601 durations or milliseconds. NullableDurationComparator with any of: eq, gt, gte, in, lt, lte, neq, nin, null

needs.description: Conditions on customer requests linked to the issue. Use some to require a matching request or length to count linked requests. CustomerNeedCollectionFilter with any of: and, comment, createdAt, customer, every, id, issue, length, or, priority, project, some, updatedAt

number.description: Matches the issue number within its team. Numbers are not unique across teams, so combine this with team when looking for a specific issue. NumberComparator with any of: eq, gt, gte, in, lt, lte, neq, nin

or.description: Alternative conditions; the issue must match at least one. Other fields at this level must still match. An empty list adds no condition.

parent.description: Conditions on the immediate parent issue. Use null: true to find top-level issues, or an ID condition to find direct sub-issues of one parent. NullableIssueFilter with any of: accumulatedStateUpdatedAt, activity, addedToCycleAt, addedToCyclePeriod, ageTime, and, archivedAt, assignee, attachments, autoArchivedAt, autoClosedAt, canceledAt, children, comments, completedAt, createdAt, creator, customerCount, customerImportantCount, cycle, cycleTime, delegate, description, dueDate, estimate, hasActiveAgentSessions, hasBlockedByRelations, hasBlockingRelations, hasDismissedAgentSessions, hasDuplicateRelations, hasErroredAgentSessions, hasMergedAgentPullRequests, hasRelatedRelations, hasSharedUsers, hasSuggestedAssignees, hasSuggestedLabels, hasSuggestedProjects, hasSuggestedRelatedIssues, hasSuggestedSimilarIssues, hasSuggestedTeams, id, labels, lastAppliedTemplate, leadTime, needs, null, number, or, parent, priority, project, projectMilestone, reactions, recurringIssueTemplate, releases, searchableContent, sharedWith, slaBreachesAt, slaStatus, snoozedBy, snoozedUntilAt, sourceMetadata, startedAt, state, subscribers, suggestions, team, title, triageTime, triagedAt, updatedAt

priority.description: Conditions on the numeric priority: 0 = No priority, 1 = Urgent, 2 = High, 3 = Medium, 4 = Low. Lower nonzero values mean higher priority. NullableNumberComparator with any of: eq, gt, gte, in, lt, lte, neq, nin, null

project.description: Conditions on the assigned project. Use null: true for issues without a project; otherwise the project must match the supplied conditions. NullableProjectFilter with any of: accessibleTeams, activityType, and, canceledAt, completedAt, completedProjectMilestones, createdAt, creator, customIdentifier, customerCount, customerImportantCount, hasBlockedByRelations, hasBlockingRelations, hasDependedOnByRelations, hasDependsOnRelations, hasRelatedRelations, hasViolatedRelations, health, healthWithAge, id, initiatives, issues, labels, lastAppliedTemplate, lead, leadTeam, members, name, needs, nextProjectMilestone, null, or, priority, projectMilestones, projectUpdates, roadmaps, searchableContent, slugId, startDate, startedAt, state, status, targetDate, updatedAt

projectMilestone.description: Filters that the issues project milestone must satisfy. NullableProjectMilestoneFilter with any of: and, createdAt, id, name, null, or, project, targetDate, updatedAt

reactions.description: Conditions on emoji reactions added directly to the issue. Reactions on its comments are filtered through comments.reactions. ReactionCollectionFilter with any of: and, createdAt, customEmojiId, emoji, every, id, length, or, some, updatedAt

recurringIssueTemplate.description: [ALPHA] Filters that the recurring issue template must satisfy. NullableTemplateFilter with any of: and, createdAt, id, inheritedFromId, name, null, or, team, type, updatedAt

releases.description: Conditions on releases linked to the issue. An issue can belong to several releases; use some to require a matching release or length to count them. ReleaseCollectionFilter with any of: and, completedAt, createdAt, every, hasReleaseNotes, id, length, name, or, pipeline, some, stage, updatedAt, version

searchableContent.description: Comparator for the issues content. ContentComparator with any of: contains, notContains

sharedWith.description: Filters that users the issue has been shared with must satisfy. UserCollectionFilter with any of: active, admin, and, app, assignedIssues, createdAt, displayName, email, every, id, invited, isInvited, isMe, length, name, or, owner, some, updatedAt

slaBreachesAt.description: Conditions on the SLA deadline. A deadline before now does not by itself mean the SLA was missed; use slaStatus to distinguish unfinished breaches from completed outcomes. NullableDateComparator with any of: eq, gt, gte, in, lt, lte, neq, nin, null

slaStatus.description: Conditions on the current SLA risk or outcome. Use null: true for issues without an SLA status, including canceled issues and issues without an SLA. SlaStatusComparator with any of: eq, in, neq, nin, null

snoozedBy.description: Filters that the issues snoozer must satisfy. NullableUserFilter with any of: active, admin, and, app, assignedIssues, createdAt, displayName, email, id, invited, isInvited, isMe, name, null, or, owner, updatedAt

snoozedUntilAt.description: Conditions on when the issue’s triage snooze ends. Use null: true for issues without a recorded snooze time. NullableDateComparator with any of: eq, gt, gte, in, lt, lte, neq, nin, null

sourceMetadata.description: Filters that the source must satisfy. SourceMetadataComparator with any of: null, subType, workflowDefinitionId

startedAt.description: Conditions on when work started. Use null: true for issues with no recorded start time; moving back to triage, backlog, or an unstarted status clears it. NullableDateComparator with any of: eq, gt, gte, in, lt, lte, neq, nin, null

state.description: Conditions on the issue’s current status. Filter by type, such as started or completed, to match the same workflow category across teams with different status names and IDs. WorkflowStateFilter with any of: and, createdAt, description, id, issues, name, or, position, team, type, updatedAt

subscribers.description: Filters that issue subscribers must satisfy. UserCollectionFilter with any of: active, admin, and, app, assignedIssues, createdAt, displayName, email, every, id, invited, isInvited, isMe, length, name, or, owner, some, updatedAt

suggestions.description: Filters that the issue's suggestions must satisfy. IssueSuggestionCollectionFilter with any of: and, createdAt, every, id, length, or, some, state, suggestedLabel, suggestedProject, suggestedTeam, suggestedUser, type, updatedAt

team.description: Filters that the issues team must satisfy. TeamFilter with any of: ancestors, and, createdAt, description, id, issues, key, members, name, or, owners, parent, private, releasePipelines, restrictedBy, retiredAt, updatedAt, users, visibility

title.description: Conditions on the issue title. This does not search descriptions or comments. StringComparator with any of: contains, containsIgnoreCase, containsIgnoreCaseAndAccent, endsWith, eq, eqIgnoreCase, in, neq, neqIgnoreCase, nin, notContains, notContainsIgnoreCase, notEndsWith, notStartsWith, startsWith, startsWithIgnoreCase

triageTime.description: Compares the elapsed time from entering triage to leaving triage. The duration is null if either timestamp is missing. Accepts ISO 8601 durations or milliseconds. NullableDurationComparator with any of: eq, gt, gte, in, lt, lte, neq, nin, null

triagedAt.description: Conditions on when the issue last left triage. The value is unset before triage is completed and after re-entering triage. NullableDateComparator with any of: eq, gt, gte, in, lt, lte, neq, nin, null

updatedAt.description: Filters by the last meaningful update time. Some background changes do not advance it. Use `gte` and `lt` together to select a time window. DateComparator with any of: eq, gt, gte, in, lt, lte, neq, nin

filterData.description: The criteria for an issue view. Use the same IssueFilter structure accepted by the issues query. Omit it for an unfiltered issue view within the view’s scope.

icon.description: Emoji name or decorative icon identifier for the view.

id.description: The identifier in UUID v4 format. If none is provided, the backend will generate one.

activityType.description: Not supported. Initiative activity is not stored on the server, so filters that set this field are rejected. StringComparator with any of: contains, containsIgnoreCase, containsIgnoreCaseAndAccent, endsWith, eq, eqIgnoreCase, in, neq, neqIgnoreCase, nin, notContains, notContainsIgnoreCase, notEndsWith, notStartsWith, startsWith, startsWithIgnoreCase

ancestors.description: Conditions on this initiative’s parent initiatives and their ancestors. For example, some: { id: { eq: ID } } finds descendants of the specified initiative. InitiativeCollectionFilter with any of: activityType, ancestors, and, canceledAt, completedAt, createdAt, creator, customIdentifier, every, health, healthWithAge, id, initiativeUpdates, labels, leadTeam, length, name, or, owner, priority, projects, searchableContent, slugId, some, startedAt, status, targetDate, teams, updatedAt

and.description: All of these nested filters must match, in addition to the other conditions on this filter.

canceledAt.description: Comparator for the initiative canceled at date. NullableDateComparator with any of: eq, gt, gte, in, lt, lte, neq, nin, null

completedAt.description: Comparator for the initiative completed at date. NullableDateComparator with any of: eq, gt, gte, in, lt, lte, neq, nin, null

createdAt.description: Filters by creation time. Use a fixed timestamp or a relative duration, such as `{ gte: "-P7D" }` for resources created in the last seven days. DateComparator with any of: eq, gt, gte, in, lt, lte, neq, nin

creator.description: Filters that the initiative creator must satisfy. NullableUserFilter with any of: active, admin, and, app, assignedIssues, createdAt, displayName, email, id, invited, isInvited, isMe, name, null, or, owner, updatedAt

customIdentifier.description: Comparator for the initiative's custom identifier. NullableStringComparator with any of: contains, containsIgnoreCase, containsIgnoreCaseAndAccent, endsWith, eq, eqIgnoreCase, in, neq, neqIgnoreCase, nin, notContains, notContainsIgnoreCase, notEndsWith, notStartsWith, null, startsWith, startsWithIgnoreCase

health.description: Comparator for the initiative health: onTrack, atRisk, offTrack StringComparator with any of: contains, containsIgnoreCase, containsIgnoreCaseAndAccent, endsWith, eq, eqIgnoreCase, in, neq, neqIgnoreCase, nin, notContains, notContainsIgnoreCase, notEndsWith, notStartsWith, startsWith, startsWithIgnoreCase

healthWithAge.description: The initiative’s health after accounting for the age of its latest update and its reminder schedule. Accepts onTrack, atRisk, offTrack, outdated, or noUpdate. StringComparator with any of: contains, containsIgnoreCase, containsIgnoreCaseAndAccent, endsWith, eq, eqIgnoreCase, in, neq, neqIgnoreCase, nin, notContains, notContainsIgnoreCase, notEndsWith, notStartsWith, startsWith, startsWithIgnoreCase

id.description: Comparator for the identifier. EntityIdentifierIDComparator with any of: eq, in, neq, nin

initiativeUpdates.description: Conditions on updates published directly to this initiative. Updates on sub-initiatives are not included in this collection. InitiativeUpdatesCollectionFilter with any of: and, createdAt, every, id, length, or, some, updatedAt

labels.description: Filters that the initiative labels must satisfy. InitiativeLabelCollectionFilter with any of: and, createdAt, creator, every, id, isGroup, length, name, null, or, parent, some, updatedAt

leadTeam.description: Conditions on the initiative’s own lead team. Use { null: true } to find workspace-level initiatives. NullableTeamFilter with any of: ancestors, and, createdAt, description, id, issues, key, members, name, null, or, owners, parent, private, releasePipelines, restrictedBy, retiredAt, updatedAt, users, visibility

name.description: Comparator for the initiative name. StringComparator with any of: contains, containsIgnoreCase, containsIgnoreCaseAndAccent, endsWith, eq, eqIgnoreCase, in, neq, neqIgnoreCase, nin, notContains, notContainsIgnoreCase, notEndsWith, notStartsWith, startsWith, startsWithIgnoreCase

or.description: At least one of these nested filters must match, in addition to the other conditions on this filter. An empty list is ignored.

owner.description: Filters that the initiative owner must satisfy. NullableUserFilter with any of: active, admin, and, app, assignedIssues, createdAt, displayName, email, id, invited, isInvited, isMe, name, null, or, owner, updatedAt

priority.description: Comparator for the initiative priority. NullableNumberComparator with any of: eq, gt, gte, in, lt, lte, neq, nin, null

projects.description: Conditions on distinct accessible projects linked to this initiative or its sub-initiatives. A project linked through several sub-initiatives is counted once. ProjectCollectionFilter with any of: accessibleTeams, activityType, and, canceledAt, completedAt, completedProjectMilestones, createdAt, creator, customIdentifier, customerCount, customerImportantCount, every, hasBlockedByRelations, hasBlockingRelations, hasDependedOnByRelations, hasDependsOnRelations, hasRelatedRelations, hasViolatedRelations, health, healthWithAge, id, initiatives, issues, labels, lastAppliedTemplate, lead, leadTeam, length, members, name, needs, nextProjectMilestone, or, priority, projectMilestones, projectUpdates, roadmaps, searchableContent, slugId, some, startDate, startedAt, state, status, targetDate, updatedAt

searchableContent.description: Comparator for the initiative's name and summary. ContentComparator with any of: contains, notContains

slugId.description: Comparator for the initiative slug ID. StringComparator with any of: contains, containsIgnoreCase, containsIgnoreCaseAndAccent, endsWith, eq, eqIgnoreCase, in, neq, neqIgnoreCase, nin, notContains, notContainsIgnoreCase, notEndsWith, notStartsWith, startsWith, startsWithIgnoreCase

startedAt.description: Comparator for the initiative started at date. NullableDateComparator with any of: eq, gt, gte, in, lt, lte, neq, nin, null

status.description: Comparator for the initiative status: Proposed, Planned, Active, Completed, Canceled StringComparator with any of: contains, containsIgnoreCase, containsIgnoreCaseAndAccent, endsWith, eq, eqIgnoreCase, in, neq, neqIgnoreCase, nin, notContains, notContainsIgnoreCase, notEndsWith, notStartsWith, startsWith, startsWithIgnoreCase

targetDate.description: Comparator for the initiative target date. NullableDateComparator with any of: eq, gt, gte, in, lt, lte, neq, nin, null

teams.description: Conditions on teams contributing through projects or lead-team associations. When team initiatives are available, this also accounts for sub-initiative projects and lead teams in the initiative hierarchy. Use leadTeam to filter only the initiative’s own lead team. TeamCollectionFilter with any of: ancestors, and, createdAt, every, id, length, or, parent, some, updatedAt

updatedAt.description: Filters by the last meaningful update time. Some background changes do not advance it. Use `gte` and `lt` together to select a time window. DateComparator with any of: eq, gt, gte, in, lt, lte, neq, nin

initiativeFilterData.description: [ALPHA] Filter for a view of initiatives. Sets the view’s modelName to Initiative when no project filter is set.

initiativeId.description: UUID of the initiative to place the view in.

name.description: The name of the custom view.

ownerId.description: UUID of the owner. Must be the current user; defaults to the current user.

actions.name: customer_create
actions.description: Creates a customer when the Customers feature is available and enabled in the workspace. Business domains and external IDs must not belong to another customer, including archived customers. If no status is supplied, the first customer status by position is used.

domains.description: The email domains associated with this customer (e.g., 'acme.com'). Public email domains are not allowed. Defaults to an empty array.

externalIds.description: External-system customer IDs, unique across customers in the workspace, including archived customers. Defaults to an empty array.

id.description: The identifier in UUID v4 format. If none is provided, the backend will generate one.

logoUrl.description: The URL of the customer's logo image.

mainSourceId.description: The external ID to select as the primary data source. Must be one of the values provided in externalIds.

name.description: The display name of the customer organization.

ownerId.description: The customer owner’s user UUID. Application accounts cannot own customers.

revenue.description: Annual revenue in whole units of the workspace’s configured revenue currency. Must be a nonnegative integer.

size.description: The size of the customer organization (e.g., number of employees).

slackChannelId.description: The ID of the Slack channel to link to this customer.

statusId.description: Customer status UUID. Defaults to the first status by position.

tierId.description: The identifier of the customer tier to assign.

select.description: What to get back, as a GraphQL selection, e.g. "id title state { name }"; leave out for the usual fields

actions.select: customer { approximateNeedCount archivedAt createdAt domains externalIds id integration { id } logoUrl mainSourceId name owner { id name title displayName email url } revenue size slackChannelId slugId status { id name displayName } tier { id name displayName } updatedAt url } lastSyncId success

targetCustomerId.description: The ID of the target customer to merge into. This customer will receive all needs from the source customer and retain its own.

actions.name: customer_need_create
actions.description: Records customer feedback, optionally linked to an issue. Unlinked requests require Customer Signals to be enabled. You can identify the customer, add Markdown feedback, or link a source attachment. Multiple requests can be recorded for the same customer and issue.

attachmentId.description: The UUID of an existing attachment to associate with this need as its source.

attachmentUrl.description: A URL to create an attachment from and associate with this customer need as its source.

commentId.description: The UUID of an existing comment to associate with this need for additional context.

createAsUser.description: Create the need attributed to an external user with the provided name. This option is only available to OAuth applications creating needs in `actor=app` mode.

createdAt.description: The time at which the customer need was created (e.g. if importing from another system). Must be a time in the past. If none is provided, the backend will generate the time as now. a date and time, ISO 8601

customerExternalId.description: The external system ID of the customer this need belongs to. Cannot be used together with customerId.

customerId.description: The UUID of the customer this need belongs to. Cannot be used together with customerExternalId.

displayIconUrl.description: Avatar URL for the external user specified in `createAsUser`. Can only be used in conjunction with `createAsUser`. This option is only available to OAuth applications creating needs in `actor=app` mode.

id.description: The identifier in UUID v4 format. If none is provided, the backend will generate one.

issueId.description: The optional issue UUID or identifier, such as LIN-123.

priority.description: Whether the customer need is important or not. 0 = Not important, 1 = Important.

actions.name: customer_need_update
actions.description: Updates a customer request, including its feedback, customer, priority, or issue association. Only manually added source attachments can be replaced or removed. Use clearAttachment to remove such a source; moving the request to another issue also moves its source attachment.

clearAttachment.description: Whether to remove the manually added source attachment. Sources managed by an integration cannot be removed this way. A different, nonempty attachmentUrl takes precedence.

id.description: The identifier of the customer need to update.

applyPriorityToRelatedNeeds.description: Whether to apply the supplied priority to other needs from the same customer on the same issue or project. This only has an effect when priority is also supplied. The mutation returns the additional changed needs in updatedRelatedNeeds.

attachmentUrl.description: An HTTP or HTTPS URL to replace the request’s source attachment. Only manually added sources can be changed; omit this field for sources managed by an integration. For editable sources, null leaves the source unchanged; use clearAttachment to remove it.

actions.name: issue_batch_create
actions.description: Creates one to 50 issues in a single batch. If any creation fails, none of the issues in the batch are saved. Put parent inputs before their sub-issues and supply parent UUIDs to connect issues created in the same batch.

assigneeId.description: The UUID of the user responsible for the issue. Omit it to use the template’s assignee, if any, or pass null to leave that default unset. Team triage rules can still assign an unassigned issue.

completedAt.description: Completion time for an imported issue. Requires createdAt and a completed status; must be in the past and not before createdAt. a date and time, ISO 8601

createAsUser.description: Display name credited with creating the issue. Available only to OAuth applications using actor=app.

createdAt.description: Creation time for imported issues. Must be in the past. Defaults to the current time. a date and time, ISO 8601

cycleId.description: The UUID of a cycle in the issue’s team. When a cycle is supplied without a status, the issue starts in the team’s default unstarted status. Team cycle settings can also assign a cycle automatically when you leave this unset.

delegateId.description: The UUID of an agent user to delegate work to. Delegation can start an agent session on the issue and requires permission to invoke that agent.

description.description: The issue’s description in Markdown. Use it for the context, requirements, and links that do not belong in the title. When creating from a template, a supplied description replaces the template’s description.

displayIconUrl.description: Avatar URL for createAsUser. Requires createAsUser and an OAuth application using actor=app.

dueDate.description: Due date in YYYY-MM-DD format, without a time or time zone. a date, YYYY-MM-DD

estimate.description: The numeric estimate, from 0 to 64. Linear maps it to the nearest value in the team’s configured scale; use numeric values even for T-shirt sizes. Zero is accepted only when the team allows it. Omit to use the template’s estimate, if any, or pass null for no estimate.

id.description: The identifier in UUID v4 format. If none is provided, the backend will generate one.

labelIds.description: The UUIDs of labels to apply. Labels must be available to the issue’s team, and a single-select group can contribute at most one label. When using a template, these labels are combined with its labels, with your choice taking precedence within a single-select group.

lastAppliedTemplateId.description: UUID of the template to record as last applied. Use templateId to apply its values.

parentId.description: The UUID or identifier of an existing parent issue, such as ENG-123. Setting this makes the new issue a sub-issue; the parent can belong to another team if you can access it.

preserveSortOrderOnCreate.description: Keep the supplied sortOrder instead of placing the issue first in its status. Defaults to false.

priority.description: The priority of the issue. 0 = No priority, 1 = Urgent, 2 = High, 3 = Medium, 4 = Low.

prioritySortOrder.description: Position among issues with the same priority. Lower values appear first.

projectId.description: UUID or identifier of the project, such as P-LIN-123. The project must include the issue’s team. If omitted for a sub-issue, the parent’s project is used when it includes that team; null leaves the issue without a project.

projectMilestoneId.description: The UUID of a milestone in the project supplied in projectId. A milestone cannot be assigned without its project.

referenceCommentId.description: The UUID of a comment whose issue should be linked to the new issue. If the comment belongs to an issue, Linear creates a related-issue relation between that issue and the new one.

releaseIds.description: The UUIDs of releases to associate with the new issue. Requires release management to be available in the workspace; the releases must exist and be accessible to you.

slaType.description: The SLA day count type for the issue. Whether SLA should be business days only or calendar days (default).

sortOrder.description: Position in manually sorted lists. Lower values appear first. Set preserveSortOrderOnCreate to keep this position.

sourceCommentId.description: The UUID of the comment from which this issue was created. Records the source comment on the issue; use referenceCommentId to also link to the comment’s issue.

stateId.description: UUID of a status in the issue’s team. Defaults to the team’s initial status, or an unstarted status when cycleId is set.

subIssueSortOrder.description: The position among the parent’s direct sub-issues, with lower values first. Requires parentId. If omitted, the new sub-issue is placed last; conflicting positions are adjusted.

subscriberIds.description: The UUIDs of users to subscribe to issue updates. Linear may also subscribe people involved in the issue, such as its assignee and users mentioned in the description.

teamId.description: UUID of the team that will own the issue.

templateId.description: The UUID of an issue template to use. Linear applies its defaults and creates any sub-issues it defines, returning the root issue. Supplied values override the template’s defaults; labelIds are combined with its labels.

title.description: The title shown in issue lists and at the top of the issue. Required unless templateId is provided; when supplied with a template, it replaces the template’s title.

useDefaultTemplate.description: Whether to apply the team’s default template. Linear selects the member or non-member default based on your team membership; if no matching default is set, creation proceeds without a template. Cannot be combined with templateId.

issues.description: The issues to create, in creation order. Put parents before their sub-issues so each parent exists when its children are created.

actions.name: issue_batch_update
actions.description: Applies the same update input to one to 50 issues. The batch runs as one transaction, so a failed update rolls back the other updates. Use the returned issues to read the resulting values.

ids.description: One to 50 distinct issue UUIDs to update.

addedLabelIds.description: Label UUIDs to add without replacing the full list. Cannot be combined with labelIds.

addedReleaseIds.description: Release UUIDs to add without replacing the full list. Cannot be combined with releaseIds.

assigneeId.description: UUID of the new assignee. Null unassigns the issue.

autoClosedByParentClosing.description: Record that this status change was caused by closing the parent issue. Requires stateId.

cycleId.description: UUID of a cycle in the issue’s team. Null removes the cycle, subject to the team’s automatic cycle assignment settings.

delegateId.description: The UUID of the agent to delegate work to. Changing the delegate can start an agent session; pass null to remove the delegate, or omit this field to keep the current one.

description.description: The replacement issue description in Markdown. Send an empty string to clear it, or omit this field to keep the current description. Null also leaves it unchanged. This replaces the full description rather than appending to it.

dueDate.description: Due date in YYYY-MM-DD format, without a time or time zone. Null clears it. a date, YYYY-MM-DD

estimate.description: The numeric estimate, from 0 to 64, mapped to the nearest value in the team’s configured scale. Zero is accepted only when the team allows it. Pass null to clear the estimate, or omit it to keep the current value.

inheritsSharedAccess.description: Whether people with shared access to the parent also receive access to this issue. Setting true requires a parent issue. Omit this field to keep the current setting.

labelIds.description: Replacement list of label UUIDs. An empty list removes all labels. Cannot be combined with addedLabelIds or removedLabelIds.

lastAppliedTemplateId.description: UUID of the template to record as last applied. Does not apply template values. Pass null to clear the recorded template, or omit to keep it.

parentId.description: The UUID or identifier of the new parent issue, such as ENG-123. Pass null to make this a top-level issue, or omit it to keep the current parent. An issue cannot be its own ancestor.

priority.description: The priority of the issue. 0 = No priority, 1 = Urgent, 2 = High, 3 = Medium, 4 = Low.

prioritySortOrder.description: Position among issues with the same priority. Lower values appear first.

projectId.description: UUID or identifier of a project that includes the issue’s team. Null removes the project and milestone.

projectMilestoneId.description: UUID of a milestone in the issue’s project. Null removes the milestone.

releaseIds.description: Replacement list of release UUIDs. An empty list removes all release links. Cannot be combined with addedReleaseIds or removedReleaseIds.

removedLabelIds.description: Label UUIDs to remove without replacing the full list. Cannot be combined with labelIds.

removedReleaseIds.description: Release UUIDs to remove without replacing the full list. Cannot be combined with releaseIds.

trashed.description: The trash marker for an already archived issue. Set true to mark it as trashed, or null to remove that marker while keeping it archived. Use issueDelete to trash an active issue and issueUnarchive to restore it to normal issue lists.

actions.name: issue_update
actions.description: Updates an issue by UUID or human-readable identifier and returns its resulting values. Omitted fields keep their values; list inputs replace their existing lists unless an add/remove field is used. Changes can also trigger team workflow behavior, such as automatic cycle assignment.

id.description: The identifier of the issue to update.

addedLabelIds.description: Label UUIDs to add without replacing the full list. Cannot be combined with labelIds.

addedReleaseIds.description: Release UUIDs to add without replacing the full list. Cannot be combined with releaseIds.

assigneeId.description: UUID of the new assignee. Null unassigns the issue.

autoClosedByParentClosing.description: Record that this status change was caused by closing the parent issue. Requires stateId.

cycleId.description: UUID of a cycle in the issue’s team. Null removes the cycle, subject to the team’s automatic cycle assignment settings.

delegateId.description: The UUID of the agent to delegate work to. Changing the delegate can start an agent session; pass null to remove the delegate, or omit this field to keep the current one.

description.description: The replacement issue description in Markdown. Send an empty string to clear it, or omit this field to keep the current description. Null also leaves it unchanged. This replaces the full description rather than appending to it.

dueDate.description: Due date in YYYY-MM-DD format, without a time or time zone. Null clears it. a date, YYYY-MM-DD

estimate.description: The numeric estimate, from 0 to 64, mapped to the nearest value in the team’s configured scale. Zero is accepted only when the team allows it. Pass null to clear the estimate, or omit it to keep the current value.

inheritsSharedAccess.description: Whether people with shared access to the parent also receive access to this issue. Setting true requires a parent issue. Omit this field to keep the current setting.

labelIds.description: Replacement list of label UUIDs. An empty list removes all labels. Cannot be combined with addedLabelIds or removedLabelIds.

lastAppliedTemplateId.description: UUID of the template to record as last applied. Does not apply template values. Pass null to clear the recorded template, or omit to keep it.

parentId.description: The UUID or identifier of the new parent issue, such as ENG-123. Pass null to make this a top-level issue, or omit it to keep the current parent. An issue cannot be its own ancestor.

priority.description: The priority of the issue. 0 = No priority, 1 = Urgent, 2 = High, 3 = Medium, 4 = Low.

prioritySortOrder.description: Position among issues with the same priority. Lower values appear first.

projectId.description: UUID or identifier of a project that includes the issue’s team. Null removes the project and milestone.

projectMilestoneId.description: UUID of a milestone in the issue’s project. Null removes the milestone.

releaseIds.description: Replacement list of release UUIDs. An empty list removes all release links. Cannot be combined with addedReleaseIds or removedReleaseIds.

removedLabelIds.description: Label UUIDs to remove without replacing the full list. Cannot be combined with labelIds.

removedReleaseIds.description: Release UUIDs to remove without replacing the full list. Cannot be combined with releaseIds.

slaType.description: How to count time for the issue’s SLA: all for calendar days, or onlyBusinessDays for the team’s working days. Omit it to keep the current setting. Changing it recalculates the risk thresholds for an existing SLA.

snoozedById.description: The UUID of the user recorded as snoozing the issue. For API requests, Linear sets this from the acting user when snoozedUntilAt changes; you cannot change it independently.

snoozedUntilAt.description: The time until which to hide the issue from triage. Pass null to clear the snooze. Linear records the acting user as snoozedBy when a snooze is set. a date and time, ISO 8601

sortOrder.description: Position in manually sorted lists. Lower values appear first.

stateId.description: UUID of a status in the issue’s team. A status change updates lifecycle times and may change cycle membership. Moving to the reserved duplicate status requires an existing duplicate relation; use issueRelationCreate to mark an issue as a duplicate.

subIssueSortOrder.description: Position among the parent’s sub-issues. Lower values appear first.

subscriberIds.description: The complete replacement list of subscriber UUIDs. An empty list removes the current subscribers; omitting the field keeps them. Assignee, delegate, or mention changes can add subscribers as part of the same update.

teamId.description: The UUID of the destination team. Moving an issue gives it a new team identifier and maps team-specific values, such as status and labels, to the destination team. Its UUID and previous identifiers are preserved.

title.description: The replacement issue title. Omit to keep the current title; an empty string or null is not accepted.

trashed.description: The trash marker for an already archived issue. Set true to mark it as trashed, or null to remove that marker while keeping it archived. Use issueDelete to trash an active issue and issueUnarchive to restore it to normal issue lists.

select.description: What to get back, as a GraphQL selection, e.g. "id title state { name }"; leave out for the usual fields

preferences.description: The complete replacement set of display overrides. Include existing keys you want to keep. An empty object removes the record’s display overrides so the view can use its fallback defaults.

select.description: What to get back, as a GraphQL selection, e.g. "id title state { name }"; leave out for the usual fields

actions.select: lastSyncId success viewPreferences { archivedAt createdAt id type updatedAt viewType }

actions.name: webhook_create
actions.description: Creates a webhook subscription and returns its configuration, including the signing secret. Choose one team or all public teams, and provide a public HTTPS destination with the resource types you want to receive. The destination must not already be registered for the same team scope. Requires workspace API management permission; a team-specific webhook also requires that team’s management permission. AuditEntry subscriptions have separate audit log access requirements.

allPublicTeams.description: Receive events from every public team, including teams created later. If true, teamId is ignored.

enabled.description: Whether matching events are delivered. Defaults to true on create.

id.description: The identifier in UUID v4 format. If none is provided, the backend will generate one.

label.description: Display label, up to 64 characters. Must not contain a URL.

resourceTypes.description: Event streams to subscribe to. Accepted values are Attachment, AuditEntry, Comment, Customer, CustomerNeed, Cycle, Document, Initiative, InitiativeUpdate, Issue, IssueLabel, IssueSLA, Project, ProjectLabel, ProjectUpdate, Reaction, Release, ReleaseNote, and User. Names are case-sensitive. AuditEntry must be the only value and requires audit log permission and plan access; other streams may also require access to their feature.

secret.description: Signing secret, up to 256 characters. A secret is generated when omitted on create.

teamId.description: UUID of the team whose events to deliver. Required unless allPublicTeams is true.

url.description: Public HTTPS endpoint that receives webhook POST requests, up to 1,000 characters.

select.description: What to get back, as a GraphQL selection, e.g. "id title state { name }"; leave out for the usual fields

actions.select: lastSyncId success webhook { allPublicTeams archivedAt createdAt creator { id name title displayName email url } enabled id label resourceTypes team { id name displayName key } updatedAt url }

actions.name: webhook_delete
actions.description: Deletes a webhook subscription and stops future deliveries.

id.description: The identifier of the Webhook to delete.

select.description: What to get back, as a GraphQL selection, e.g. "id title state { name }"; leave out for the usual fields

actions.select: entityId lastSyncId success

actions.name: webhook_rotate_secret
actions.description: Generates and returns a new HMAC-SHA256 signing secret for the webhook. Update your receiver to verify later deliveries with the returned key; the previous key is replaced rather than kept as a second active key. This changes webhook signatures, not the endpoint or subscribed event streams.

id.description: The identifier of the Webhook to rotate the secret for.

select.description: What to get back, as a GraphQL selection, e.g. "id title state { name }"; leave out for the usual fields

actions.select: lastSyncId success

actions.name: webhook_update
actions.description: Updates an existing webhook without changing its team scope. Omitted properties remain unchanged, and resourceTypes replaces the complete list of event streams. Setting enabled to false pauses delivery while retaining the subscription. Changing secret changes the key your receiver must use for later deliveries. Requires workspace API management permission and access to the subscribed resource types.

id.description: The identifier of the Webhook.

enabled.description: Whether matching events are delivered. Set false to pause delivery, or omit to keep the current setting.

label.description: Display label, up to 64 characters. Must not contain a URL.

resourceTypes.description: Event streams to subscribe to. Accepted values are Attachment, AuditEntry, Comment, Customer, CustomerNeed, Cycle, Document, Initiative, InitiativeUpdate, Issue, IssueLabel, IssueSLA, Project, ProjectLabel, ProjectUpdate, Reaction, Release, ReleaseNote, and User. Names are case-sensitive. AuditEntry must be the only value and requires audit log permission and plan access; other streams may also require access to their feature.

secret.description: Replacement signing secret, up to 256 characters. Omit to keep the current secret. Update your receiver to verify later deliveries with the replacement.

url.description: Public HTTPS endpoint that receives webhook POST requests, up to 1,000 characters.

select.description: What to get back, as a GraphQL selection, e.g. "id title state { name }"; leave out for the usual fields

actions.select: lastSyncId success webhook { allPublicTeams archivedAt createdAt creator { id name title displayName email url } enabled id label resourceTypes team { id name displayName key } updatedAt url }

actions.name: workflow_state_archive
actions.description: Archives an unused status so it is no longer available for new issues. First move or archive every active issue in that status. You must be able to manage the team, and cannot archive reserved or inherited statuses or the last active status of a type.

id.description: The identifier of the state to archive.

select.description: What to get back, as a GraphQL selection, e.g. "id title state { name }"; leave out for the usual fields

actions.select: entity { archivedAt color createdAt description id inheritedFrom { id name } name position team { id name displayName key } type updatedAt } lastSyncId success

actions.name: workflow_state_create
actions.description: Add an issue status to a team. Requires permission to manage the team; inherited workflows cannot be edited directly.

color.description: Status color as a hexadecimal CSS color, such as #5E6AD2.

description.description: A short explanation of when your team should use this status. Omit it when the name already provides enough context.

id.description: The identifier in UUID v4 format. If none is provided, the backend will generate one.

name.description: The name of the state.

position.description: Display position within the status type, with lower values first. Defaults to the end of that type; collisions are adjusted.

teamId.description: UUID of the team that owns the status.

type.description: The workflow category: backlog, unstarted, started, completed, or canceled. This controls issue lifecycle behavior and cannot be changed later. Triage and duplicate are reserved categories and cannot be created through this mutation.

select.description: What to get back, as a GraphQL selection, e.g. "id title state { name }"; leave out for the usual fields

actions.select: lastSyncId success workflowState { archivedAt color createdAt description id inheritedFrom { id name } name position team { id name displayName key } type updatedAt }

actions.name: workflow_state_update
actions.description: Update a status’s name, color, description, or position. Requires permission to manage the team. Reserved and inherited statuses cannot be changed.

id.description: The identifier of the state to update.

color.description: Status color as a hexadecimal CSS color, such as #5E6AD2.

description.description: The explanation of when to use this status. Pass null to clear it, or omit the field to keep the current description.

name.description: The name of the state.

position.description: Display position within the status type, with lower values first. Collisions are adjusted.

select.description: What to get back, as a GraphQL selection, e.g. "id title state { name }"; leave out for the usual fields

actions.select: lastSyncId success workflowState { archivedAt color createdAt description id inheritedFrom { id name } name position team { id name displayName key } type updatedAt }
